sources.snippet: Kisoku 1.6B (base) Kisoku 1.6B is a base (not chat) language model pretrained from random initialization by one person, Joseph Rodriguez at 0ARCH, on a TPU v4-32 from Google's TPU Research Cloud. It has 1,600,749,056 parameters, saw about 0.5 trillion tokens of pretraining text (524.4B including the long-context phases), and was extended to 64K tokens of context.
